relations.text_en: Co-owns the Pine Run Midstream joint venture

source.label: UGI 10-K(2026年9月期)
source.quote: Including its joint venture with Stonehenge Energy Holdings III LLC in Pine Run Midstream, Energy Services' subsidiary, UGI Appalachia, consists of 11 natural gas gathering systems with approximately 375 miles of natural gas gathering pipelines and gas compressors and one processing plant in southwestern Pennsylvania, eastern Ohio, and the panhandle of West Virginia.

relations.text_en: Long-term transportation agreement with its Texas Eastern unit

source.label: UGI 10-K(2026年9月期)
source.quote: For its transportation and storage functions, PA Gas Utility has long-term agreements with a number of pipeline companies, including Texas Eastern Transmission, LP, Columbia Gas Transmission, LLC, Transcontinental Gas Pipeline Company, LLC, Eastern Gas Transmission and Storage, Inc., Tennessee Gas Pipeline Company, L.L.C., and Energy Services and its subsidiaries (including UGI Storage Company and UGI Sunbury, LLC).
